title: MEIKO — Wink, I Was Never Here!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day of the reading event
Elementary School - Gym

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Okay, I should be able to watch what happens on stage without being seen by anyone else...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Honami certainly found a good place for her phone.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (As for the children... Hehe. They seem to have settled down.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I was worried a second ago since they were so restless...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But now, they seem to be really looking forward to hearing the story.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Those two look very calm.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Based on their expressions, I think they're ready.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And I'm sure they'll do just fine.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Regardless of who comes to see them, good musicians are able to captivate the audience with their music.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (These two know how to do just that, so I'm sure they'll put on a solid performance. Break a leg, girls.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, let's get into the story...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Promise to listen quietly for us until the end?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: We promise!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: We wanna see the doggy again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “The next stop along the dog's journey was a forested land of many trees.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Hmm... This is bad. I won't be able to work if I don't find it.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “A burly lumberjack has lost his faithful axe.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“I'll help search for your axe, Mr. Lumberjack.
I should be able to find it using my nose.”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah! Dogs have really good noses, right?!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: They do?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Honami's voice has this nice bounce to it.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I can tell that she's really enjoying reading to them.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I felt this during their rehearsal, but this Nene girl is such a great actress.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She's playing all these different roles, but she's nailed down the voices for each of them.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (They're working in perfect sync with one another.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This is different from the performances I'm used to seeing, the kind that feels like a burst of emotion...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But it might be nice to see more slow-paced shows like this from time to time.)
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What a wonderful performance...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (It felt like I was traveling alongside that dog as he went on his journey.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (My heart was filled with so much warmth and kindness...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And the children seemed to really enjoy the story, which makes the event a big success.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Where have you been? We couldn't find you at all.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I went over to see Honami read.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh...
Are you talking about the reading event she said she'd be doing...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
It was a little different from her usual performances, but it was still very good nonetheless.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Whether she's putting on the best performance she can to move others with her music, or trying to get children to enjoy the story she loves so much...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Her sense of drive doesn't change.)
